content.text: {"stops":[{"poi_id":"p1","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Temples tucked into the karst, caves cool as a sea breeze, and views that make the climb worth it."},{"poi_id":"p8","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Soft sand, gentle waves, and a horizon that never hurries."},{"poi_id":"p11","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Weave through the stalls for dried squid, coffee beans, and a little bargaining banter."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p10","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m1","note":"Old sandstone dancers and gods, all watching you with that calm Chăm smile. Give them a slow hour."},{"poi_id":"p27","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Egg coffee thick as a hug, right where the dragon sleeps. Sip it slow and watch the bridge wake up."},{"poi_id":"p3","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m2","note":"Red socks on, eyes on the river. The dragon breathes fire and the whole skyline leans in to watch."},{"poi_id":"p16","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Up high the city turns to glitter and the sea is just a dark whisper. Five days of river lights, marble, Sơn Trà, dragon fire and old stones — every must-do tucked in, ngon quá!
